rows.grounds: absolutive of √dā; refers back to the offerings given in sequence in the preceding verses
prescribes the ritual act of waving light (ārati/nīrājana)
object of the light-waving rite; the goddess Śrī

items.question: Which concluding ritual act is owed to Śrī after the preceding offerings have been given?
premises: The preceding offerings have already been given in due order.
A ritual act of waving light is prescribed.
Śrī is the recipient of this prescribed act.
items.inference: Therefore, after giving the preceding offerings, one should perform the waving of light before Śrī.
uncertainties: Whether śriyam refers specifically to the goddess or to her image is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Having given the offerings, one should wave light before Śrī.
